description: Our existing participants are good at brainstorming , storytelling,  photography and videography!! join us! Together we shall reach the stars!
summary: It's a children's book that explains and shows the equipment left behind on the moon and Mars. It's fully hand illustrated and it's important because it teaches young children about space travel and why the equipment is necessary and why it's used.
details: It's a book that explains the purpose of the equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. It showcases pictures of different equipment left behind and explains why they were left behind and their function. We used canva to draw the illustrations and type out the book. We also used chatgpt to enhance our text. It's creative because it's a fully hand drawn book. We considered the fact that we're short on time and the fact that hand drawing the equipment is something we wouldnt be able to complete within the required submission period so we just copy illustrations on every page but added pictures of the equipment insted of drawing it.
